findings.title: .env file is not gitignored
findings.fixPrompt:
Fix one warning security issue that DeployReady found in this project.

Where: .env
Issue: .env file is not gitignored (CWE-538, A02:2025)
What to change: Add `.env` to .gitignore before your first commit. If it was ever committed, remove it from git history and rotate any exposed secrets.

Keep the fix minimal: change only what this issue needs, do not change behaviour or refactor unrelated code, and never put real secrets in code or in your reply (use environment variables).
To confirm: re-run `npx deployready@latest analyze` and check this issue is gone, or call the DeployReady MCP `verify` tool with id "87c326d184f2".
